features.name: Document Import
features.description: Users can import .txt and .md files via ImportPanel with file picker
features.evidence: Manual GUI verification on 2026-10-19: Electron opened, importing a .txt file succeeded, it appeared in the document list, and selecting it showed metadata and full content. The preload runtime failure (module not found: ../shared/types) was fixed by making IPC_CHANNELS a const enum; the current compiled preload has no ../shared/types runtime require. Still unverified: .md import, picker cancellation, unsupported formats, size-limit validation (including the boundary), and delete behavior.

features.name: Document Detail with Content
features.description: DocumentDetail shows full document content, metadata, and delete button
features.evidence: Manual GUI verification on 2026-10-19: selecting the imported .txt document displayed its metadata and full content. The delete action remains unverified.

features.name: Basic Persistence
features.description: Imported documents persist across app restarts via filesystem storage
features.evidence: User-confirmed manual GUI restart verification: Electron was fully closed and reopened; previously imported documents automatically reappeared without reimporting, metadata remained available, and full document content was accessible. Automated checks were also run separately: npm.cmd run check and npm.cmd run build passed on 2026-10-19. Persistence uses app.getPath('userData')/knowledge-base-data with documents-meta.json and content/<id>.txt; App loads the persisted document list on startup.
